scenes.barely.detail: (only {efficiency}% of the ideal distance): feet blocked by terrain, slipping in place, or not enough torque. Scrub the timeline to see where it stalls.
scenes.caveat: Gravity and air density for other worlds are approximate values (NASA fact sheets and Wikipedia) and have not been re-checked item by item in this session; wind acts only on the sail, not the body; soft ground and sand are not modelled.
scenes.intro: Pick a scene, run a full MuJoCo simulation, then replay it in 3D. Feet turn green on contact and orange in the air.
scenes.noReplay: No replay yet: click "Run and replay".
scenes.stalled.noStart.detail: (or moved too slowly to finish): at this wind speed the sail torque cannot overcome the starting load. Try a higher wind speed, or switch to Venus.
scenes.stuck.detail: : blocked by terrain, or the load exceeded the motor torque limit.
